title: Reconcile admin visual language and Filter Preset handoff
description: Use screenshot evidence and a generated visual concept to correct the admin direction without reopening the CPT builder scope.
objective: Make Filter Preset creation understandable at first glance: define a preset, immediately hand it to Elementor/Theme Builder, add filters, and keep advanced runtime settings available but intentionally collapsed.
inputs_required: Simple Budget Plugin Elementor template bridge reference
expected_outputs: Filter Preset form places the Elementor/Theme Builder handoff near preset setup instead of after the full form.
New presets can use a save-and-open action that creates the preset and immediately opens its Elementor template when Elementor is available.
Preset behavior exposes only first-pass essentials at first glance.
Provider, selectors, text overrides, pagination, result count, sort, and per-filter matching controls remain available behind advanced disclosures.
Admin CSS shifts to a quieter hybrid WordPress/product style shared by Presets, Post Types, Dashboard, and Diagnostics.
Evidence screenshots are recaptured after implementation.
acceptance_criteria: The first viewport of a preset form shows preset setup and Theme Builder handoff before filter rows.
A user can save a new preset and create/open an Elementor template from the same primary workflow.
Provider mode and target/item selectors are not visible in the default first-glance flow.
Advanced settings are not removed from the saved option schema.
CPT repeatable field behavior remains unchanged.
Screenshots no longer show a heavy custom app shell competing with WordPress admin chrome.
verification: WP-CLI smoke saves a new preset through the save-and-open path and verifies template metadata.
Browser smoke checks preset add-filter behavior, advanced options disclosure, and CPT add-field behavior.
Playwright screenshots capture Dashboard, Filter Presets, Preset form, Post Types, Post Type form, and Diagnostics after changes.
MCP validate_decision for DEC-EIT-013 returned valid.
MCP validate_task for TASK-017 returned valid.
MCP validate_test for TEST-EIT-HYBRID-ADMIN-FLOW returned valid.
PHP lint passed through Docker PHP runtime.
JS syntax check passed for assets/js/eit-admin.js.
Browser smoke confirmed Add filter, Advanced options disclosure, Save and open in Elementor, and Add field behaviors.
WP-CLI metadata smoke verified preset task-017-qa-filters had two filters and Elementor template 291 had filter_controller metadata.
QA preset, template 291, and QA user were removed after evidence capture.
Agentic Ops snapshot SNAPSHOT-1779158060112 was created.

budgets.context_budget: FilterPresetAdmin, admin CSS, admin JS, screenshot evidence
budgets.scope_budget: admin visual language and preset handoff only
budgets.validation_budget: MCP plus WP-CLI smoke plus browser screenshots

risks: The bridge still creates Elementor Library templates, not full Elementor Pro Theme Builder conditions.
The UI can become too native and lose product identity if all custom affordances are removed.
Over-collapsing settings can make advanced capability feel hidden instead of intentionally staged.
